name: rahat
description: Rahat prototype. Not an official service. All identity, payment and data services are simulated.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.migrate: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory backend python -m app.export_openapi && npm --prefix frontend run gen:api
scripts.typecheck: uv run --directory backend mypy && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run check:bundle
scripts.verify:fast: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:fast && npm run lint:mock
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:web && npm run lint:mock
scripts.db:stop: uv run --directory backend python -m app.devdb stop
scripts.install:all: uv sync --directory backend && npm --prefix frontend install
